text:
sara: Heads-up — customers are reporting 502s in prod-eu and incidentbot didn’t page the on-call. I看到 missed pages in the alert router logs. Anyone watching?
ashok: I’m seeing the same in the router metrics — pages were marked suppressed with reason=ttl_expired. Notably the event age is ~4m when it hit the suppressor.
incident-bot: automated: alert_id=evt-9f2a, action=suppress, reason=ttl_expired, route=pagerflow-eu, attempts=0
maria: did incidentbot fall back to sms/email?
ashok: no fallback triggered — suppressor returns 200 and stops the fanout. Looks like the metadata TTL header is being stripped earlier in the pipeline for some batched alerts.
ryan_oncall: I just woke up to a manual page from maria. Oncall and joining. Are we seeing customer impact?
sara: Initial telemetry: ~48 unique sessions erroring across multiple clusters, spike duration ~2m. Potentially user-facing for paid tenants in EU region.
deploy-bot: deploy 1713246000 to alert-ingress completed 09:11 UTC
ashok: that deploy touched the ingress header sanitizer. Hypothesis: header sanitizer removed x-incident-ttl for batched webhooks when Content-Type changed to multipart.
maria: I manually re-routed the event to /pagerflow/sms-bypass and re-invoked incidentbot for the current alerts. Ryan — did you get the manual page?
ryan_oncall: yes got it, acked and triaging now. Confirmed that new pages are arriving once I requeued via the bypass endpoint.
sara: mitigation plan: 1) rollback ingress sanitizer change (short-term) 2) add defensive header restore in alert-ingress (mid-term) 3) add alert-age guard in incidentbot so TTL loss doesn’t suppress pages (long-term)
ashok: rolling back the sanitizer change now. Command: ```kubectl rollout undo deploy/alert-ingress -n infra --to-revision=1713245```
deploy-bot: rollback started for alert-ingress — pods terminating and recreating
maria: while rollback runs, I kicked off a backfill to requeue suppressed alerts: ```curl -X POST "https://alert-internal/requeue?suppress_reason=ttl_expired" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"```
ryan_oncall: receiving new pages from the backfill. Paging restored. Continuing to monitor customer errors.
sara: FYI customer impact summary so far: peak ~48 sessions, error spike ~2m, no evidence of data loss, impact limited to EU region API transactions. We should notify CS with a short blurb.
maria: assigning postmortem owner: @ashok — can you own RCA and follow-ups?
ashok: I’ll own RCA and follow-ups. Immediate actions: (a) revert sanitizer change (done), (b) add unit test for header preservation in multipart path, (c) incidentbot guard for missing TTL, (d) alerting for suppressor suppression-rate spike
ryan_oncall: thumbs-up. I’ll add a runbook tweak: incidentbot suppression should create an informational page if suppression rate > 0.5%/min to avoid silent gaps.
sara: agreed. Maria, can you draft the CS/status note that we had a brief paging outage affecting EU API calls and that we mitigated with manual pages? Keep it short.
maria: will do and post to #customer-success in ~15m.
incident-bot: automated: suppression_rate=0.24% over 5m window, suppressed_events=12
ashok: logging note — captured the original webhook payloads for the failed events at s3://redwood-ops/incident-backups/1713246801/ for RCA.
sara: closing loop: rollback confirmed healthy, backfill requeued alerts, on-call paged and triaged. We’ll open a postmortem ticket and tag CS + Eng. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
